Definition: from G5557 and G1146; gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry:--with a gold ring.
BiblicalUsage: A man with a gold ring walks into the assembly in fine clothing, and James says the church must not give him the good seat while the poor man stands. The ring is the whole sermon: wealth worn where everyone can see it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe James is right that favouritism by wealth is a denial of the gospel, because God chose the poor of this world to be rich in faith.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
